scope: Actual isolated Rime/Lua sessions with candidate-version and frontend-action guards; no TSF or OS input injection

checks.name: Lua inspection exposes exact full definition without input or commit changes
frontend and keyboard actions use the same Lua English commit
consumed action cannot duplicate English
editing pinyin invalidates an open menu target
old page target is rejected while current page has its own full definition
paging back to identical candidates does not revive a stale target
candidate selection invalidates old actions and commits the selected word
learning off hides the definition and blocks English without losing composition
turning learning back on does not revive an old action
partial candidate retains its definition but cannot drop remaining pinyin
Chinese segmented input still completes after a rejected menu action
caret movement invalidates the action and prevents partial English
missing definition remains unavailable without changing Chinese input
focus invalidation rejects the old menu without committing elsewhere
new real Rime session rejects an identical previous-session target
cached or edited display text cannot become committed English
out-of-range candidate target is harmless
opening an empty menu does not consume pending Chinese commit
menu action commits the complete long definition
zero key without a private request cannot submit English
